# Benchmarking Skill Utility

## Core principle

Measure marginal task success and quality attributable to a skill under controlled comparisons. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- single anecdotal success without a baseline
- production promotion without paired runs
